Title: General availability: Azure Data Explorer Dashboards

Body.Content:
We are thrilled to announce the much-anticipated General Availability of ADX Dashboards!

ADX Dashboards provide the ability to create various types of data visualizations in one place and in an easy-to-digest form. Dashboards can be shared broadly and allow multiple stakeholders to view dynamic, real time, fresh data while easily interacting with it to gain desired insights. With ADX Dashboards, you can build a dashboard, share it with others, and empower them to continue their data exploration journey.

ADX Dashboards which are part of the Azure Data Explorer web UI, have a user-friendly interface, allowing users to quickly explore and analyze their data without needing extensive technical knowledge. They offer a range of customization options and are designed to handle big data. When workign with ADX Dashboards users also gain:

  • Optimized dashboard rendering performance, built for large data sets and complex queries.
  • Easy creation of Dashboards based on KQL queries written in the ADX web UI.
  • Native query exploration in ADX web UI from Dashboards.

With this milestone, ADX Dashboards are now available in all Azure clouds. Our team is committed to continue investing in this product to deliver the best dashboarding experience for our customers.

More information about ADX Dashboards can be found here.
